I sat down to test out Replit’s new Agent 3 update and it blew me away. In this episode I walk through exactly how I used it to spin up a working app in under an hour, without writing code myself. I talk about what makes Agent 3 different from previous versions, how it handles debugging and building in the background, and why this could be a game changer for anyone looking to launch fast. Along the way I share my process for validating an idea, getting an MVP live, and connecting it all with tools like Stripe and Resend.
